turns.text: New year, same commute. I'm a logistics manager at a shipping company in Tuas and the drive from Tampines is killing me.
That's a long way across the island. Do you drive or take the company bus?
Drive. Leaving at 6.30am is the only way to beat the PIE jam.
Early starts it is. A good podcast might help the drive.
Had ACL reconstruction surgery on my left knee last Thursday, so I'm stuck on the sofa for a while. Recommend me a series to binge?
Sorry to hear about the knee. ACL recovery is slow, so a long series helps. Have you watched Slow Horses?
Not yet. Is it very violent? My wife doesn't like gory stuff.
Some tense scenes but nothing gory. It's more dry British humour than blood.
My wife Mei Ling's birthday is on the 14th, same day as Valentine's. Any Peranakan restaurant ideas?
Candlenut in Dempsey is a nice choice, or Violet Oon at the National Gallery for the view.
Violet Oon sounds good, she loves the dry laksa there.
Book early, the 14th will be packed.
Reunion dinner was at my grandma's in Ang Mo Kio. She made pineapple tarts for 40 people, at 84 years old.
That's impressive. Did she share the recipe?
Physio twice a week at Changi General now. My physio Farah is strict, she makes me do leg presses and balance work until I'm shaking.
Strict physios get results. Are you seeing progress?
Can finally walk without the brace. Small wins.
That's a big milestone. Keep at it.
Work is chaos. We're moving our whole warehouse system to SAP by June and I'm the one coordinating it.
Big migration. Do you have a cutover plan yet?
Draft only. Can you give me a simple checklist for the cutover weekend?
Freeze transactions, back up, migrate master data, then open balances, reconcile stock counts, and keep a rollback plan ready.
Got into pour-over coffee. Bought a Hario V60 and a hand grinder, my mornings are a ritual now.
Nice. Try a 1:16 ratio to start, about 15g of coffee to 250g of water.
Need to renew my passport. We're going to Hokkaido in December for the snow, first time for the kids.
You can renew online through ICA. Do it early, December trips book out fast.
Done, applied today. Collection in two weeks.
Great, one less thing to worry about.
My futsal kakis keep asking when I'm coming back. Surgeon says no futsal before August at the earliest.
Annoying, but August isn't far. You could still join them for kopi after their games.
Signed my daughter Chloe up for swimming lessons on Saturday mornings at Tampines Hub. She's 6 and scared of putting her face in the water.
Very common at 6. Bubble-blowing games in the bath can help her get used to it.
Attempting laksa from scratch this weekend. Is it worth making the rempah myself or should I buy the paste?
Homemade rempah tastes far better if you have the time. Fry it low and slow until the oil splits.
Ok, I'll go all in. Mei Ling is doubtful.
Prove her wrong. Good luck.
My Honda Vezel is due for its 60,000km servicing. Should I go back to the authorised dealer or a workshop?
A trusted independent workshop is usually cheaper for routine servicing once the warranty is over.

Valentine's dinner with Alicia tonight. Honestly I need to stop smoking. I'm at a pack a day and I want to be done with cigarettes before our wedding in November.
Quitting a pack-a-day habit is hard but very doable in nine months. Have you picked a quit date?
Not yet. Anyway, can you suggest a dinner spot in Dempsey for tonight?
Candlenut or PS. Cafe both work. Call ahead, Valentine's is busy.
Badminton with the office gang every Wednesday at Toa Payoh. I keep losing to our intern, he's 22 and never gets tired.
Youth is hard to beat. Work on placement instead of power.
My mum turns 65 next week. Thinking of a jade bracelet. Is that too old-fashioned?
Jade is a classic for a 65th and many mums love it. Pick a simple bangle she can wear daily.
Ok, will check out Chinatown this weekend.
Bring her wrist size if you can.
Started on nicotine patches from Guardian last week. The dreams are insane, last night I was being chased by a giant durian.
Vivid dreams are a common side effect. Some people take the patch off before bed, ask the pharmacist.
URA submission for the clubhouse is due Friday. My boss wants three facade options by tomorrow.
Tight. Vary one thing per option, like the material, so they're quick to produce.
Good idea. Timber, perforated metal and a green wall.
Clear choices for the client too.
Finished my Master Grade Zaku last night. Gundam models are the only thing that calms my brain.
MG Zakus are satisfying. Panel lining next?
We collect keys for our BTO in Tengah next month! Need a reno budget plan.
Congrats! Start with the fixed items: flooring, carpentry, electrical. Then furniture.
Budget is about $45k for a 4-room.
Doable if you keep the carpentry simple.
I'm chewing mint gum non-stop at the office now. Every time the client emails, I reach for the gum instead of going downstairs.
Whatever works. Make it sugar-free, for your teeth.
Craving bak kut teh. Song Fa or Ng Ah Sio?
Song Fa for classic peppery Teochew style, Ng Ah Sio if you want it even more peppery. Both are good.
Booked our wedding banquet at Parkroyal Collection Pickering, 30 tables. Alicia cried when we saw the ballroom.
Beautiful venue. Have you settled the guest list yet?
Still cutting. My mum wants to invite her entire church choir.
Maybe give each side a fixed number of tables.
National Day at home with Alicia and our cat Kopi, watching the parade on TV. Kopi hates the fireworks.
Cats and fireworks don't mix. A covered box in a quiet room can help Kopi feel safe.

My younger sister Aisyah is doing her O-levels this year. I'm tutoring her in maths on Sunday nights.

Cracked my iPhone 13 screen. Apple or a third-party shop at Sim Lim?

Nadia wants us to go to Bali in October. Ubud or Canggu?
Ubud for rice terraces and quiet, Canggu for beaches and cafes. Split it if you have a week.
Five days only.

turns.text: Busy season starts this week. I'm an audit senior at a Big Four firm, so goodbye weekends until March.
That's a long stretch. Anything you want to protect?
Sleep, mainly.
Then set a hard stop time on most nights.
My pottery class in Jalan Besar is on Sundays at 10. This week we threw cylinders and mine collapsed three times.
Everyone's first cylinders collapse. Usually it's too much water or uneven pressure.
I was diagnosed with generalised anxiety disorder last year, and busy season really sets it off. Can you help me plan a realistic week?
Of course. With GAD, short breaks and a fixed sleep time help. Try a hard stop at 10pm, a 10-minute walk after lunch, and one free evening.
The walk I can do. The 10pm stop, my manager will laugh.
Then aim for 11pm and protect it on most nights.
My brother Jun Hao is getting married in Perth in September! His fiancée is Australian.
Congratulations to him. Spring in Perth is lovely in September.
Doing overnight oats for meal prep. Any flavour combos that aren't boring?
Try peanut butter and banana, matcha with white sesame, or mango with coconut yoghurt.
The matcha one sounds good.
Add a little honey, matcha can be bitter.
Session with Dr Lim today, my psychologist. I see her every two weeks. We worked on catching my catastrophising before it spirals.
That sounds useful. Did she give you anything to practise?
Writing down the worst case, then the most likely case.
Simple and effective.
Moving to a rental in Bishan with my friend Clara at the end of the month. Any checklist?
Read the tenancy agreement carefully, photograph the flat at handover, and set up utilities in advance.
Booking flights to Perth for Jun Hao's wedding. Direct, or via KL to save money?
Direct is only about five hours. Worth it unless the saving is big.
It saves $180.
Your call, but the layover adds about four hours.
Presenting to the partners tomorrow. I'll do my box breathing in the loo beforehand like always.
Good routine. In for four, hold four, out for four, hold four. You've got this.
Glazed my first set of four bowls in celadon at pottery! One cracked in the kiln but three survived.
Three out of four is a good kiln rate for a beginner.
Looking after my neighbour's corgi Biscuit this weekend. He eats everything.
Keep shoes and cables out of reach and he'll be fine.
He already ate a sock.
Watch him for vomiting. If he seems unwell, call a vet.
Thinking of leaving external audit for an internal audit role at a bank. Better hours, slightly less pay.
A common move after a few busy seasons. What matters more to you right now?
Honestly, my weekends.
Then internal audit makes sense.
Haidilao with Clara tonight to celebrate our first months in the flat. We always get the tomato soup base.
Good choice. Order the noodle dance for the show.

turns.text: Moving out of my old flat in Clementi into a studio in Kallang this weekend. Give me a packing checklist?
Pack by room, label boxes, keep a day-one box with chargers, toiletries and documents, and photograph cable setups before unplugging.
Day-one box is genius.
It saves the first night.
My old landlord in Clementi is refusing to return my $2,400 deposit. Says the walls need repainting, which is rubbish, it's normal wear and tear.
That's frustrating. Keeping a deposit back for normal wear and tear can often be challenged. Did you take move-out photos?
Yes, every room on the last day. Now he's just ignoring my messages.
Keep everything in writing. If he won't respond, you can look at the Small Claims Tribunals.
I'm a data analyst at a telco. This month I'm building churn dashboards in Tableau and the data is a mess.
Churn data always is. Start by agreeing on what counts as churned.

Finally sent my first V4 at the bouldering gym near my place! Three weeks of falling off the same move.
Congrats! The first V4 feels huge.
Filed my claim at the Small Claims Tribunals today. Hearing is set for 14 July.
Good that it's in. Organise your evidence by date before the hearing.
Will do. Bit nervous, never been to a tribunal.
They're informal by design. You'll mostly just explain your side.
My parents are visiting from Chennai in June for two weeks. First time in Singapore.
Exciting. Will they stay with you in the studio?
Booked them a hotel nearby, the studio is too small.
Smart choice.
Trying to make chicken biryani in the Instant Pot. The rice came out mushy.
Use less water than on the stovetop, about 1:1.25 for soaked basmati, and let the pressure release naturally.
Need a plan for my parents. Dad loves plants, Mum loves temples.
Gardens by the Bay and the Botanic Gardens for your dad, Sri Mariamman and Sri Srinivasa Perumal temples for your mum.
Printing all my WhatsApp chats with Mr Goh and the move-out photos, putting them in a folder for July.
Good. Add a one-page timeline at the front so it's easy to follow.
Learning dbt for work. My manager wants our SQL models version-controlled.

Our team won the semi-final of the weekend cricket league! I took two wickets.

Good luck.
Bought a standing desk from IKEA for the studio. Assembly took me three hours.
Worth it for your back. Remember to alternate standing and sitting.

Good that you're stable. With HIV meds, consistency is what matters, so keep a phone alarm on Singapore time and carry a spare dose in your crew bag.
Spare dose in the crew bag is smart.

My sourdough starter Gerald finally doubled in four hours. Bread this weekend!

Quarterly check-up at NCID tomorrow, blood draw at 8am. Any tips for a long wait?

Sounds like Ipoh.
24-hour layover in Zurich next week. What can I do?
